faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Samagra Shiksha DNH DD for various education sector posts on a short-term contract basis across the Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu region.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 32 vacancies available for various posts, including BRPs, Special Educators, Accountants, Data Entry Operators, and Academic Experts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 09 October 2026. Candidates are advised to complete their submissions prior to the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves a walk-in interview scheduled on specific dates in October 2026 depending on the respective posts applied for by the candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The monthly salary ranges from Rs. 20,000/- to Rs. 35,000/- depending on the specific post, qualification requirements, and experience levels required for the role.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is typically between 30 to 40 years depending on the specific post. Please refer to the official notification for exact post-wise age criteria.

faq.question: Q7. What is the required minimum qualification?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is graduate, with specific posts requiring B.Ed., D.El.Ed., post-graduation, or specialized diplomas depending on the role requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to these contract-based positions under Samagra Shiksha DNH DD.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for Samagra Shiksha DNH DD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official website or using the direct application link provided in the important links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can find and download the official notification PDF by clicking the designated link provided in the important links table of this recruitment guide.
